next_step: Preregister an input-only synthetic full-work-accounting feasibility contract using existing causal witnesses; validate stage ownership, idle gaps, delayed feedback and an event-driven scalar comparator. No new scoring or optimization.
remaining_hypothesis: A sparse asynchronous SNN implementation may reduce complete deployment work at equal useful predictions versus an equally event-driven scalar implementation. This is unmeasured, not ANN-exclusive.

required_work_contract.comparator: Same causal native input and shared current/history access; sufficient history and event-driven scalar emulator with identical receipt/expiry scheduling. No compulsory dense polling or free reference/observer computation.
required_work_contract.gate: Quality/source/causal/state/write gates remain prerequisites for useful-system benefit; synthetic work feasibility alone never promotes runtime or establishes natural-data usefulness.
required_work_contract.measurement: Separate deployment from data generation, reference checks, hashing, replay and instrumentation. Report idle baseline, wall/CPU time, live/transient memory and hardware/sampling scope. Energy remains pending independent measurement.
required_work_contract.ownership: Every native input, observer update/projection, prediction, delayed receipt, timer expiry and maintenance action has one stage/arm owner. Charge shared stages to every arm; report physical shared execution separately.
required_work_contract.units: Keep source-level visits, writes, bytes, CPU seconds and joules separate. Do not add heterogeneous counts or substitute wire bytes/routes/peak queue length for memory/total work.
required_work_contract.writes: Compare positive actual changed local writes, including every changed counter; count attempts, allocations, queue/state/metadata writes separately. Freeze evaluation learning.
